description: Use this when the user has a name and wants to know which extensions are free and what each costs to own. Checks one label across up to 50 extensions (or a preset: popular, tech, cheap, country:<cc>) and sorts the free ones by total cost.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency for prices (default USD); converted at the ECB's daily rate, disclosed in `fx`

include_limited_promos.description: count limited promotions (one per customer, first-time customers only) in totals and rankings; default false: they are listed and flagged promo_limited, but year 1 is priced at the regular price

include_resellers.description: include registrars whose prices are a reseller account's tier (pricing_tier reseller, e.g. eNom); default false

max_renew_price.description: leave out extensions whose cheapest renewal is above this (in `currency`)

items.description: an extension: com, .io, co.uk or рф

name: search_name_across_tlds

results.description: available first, cheapest to own first; then unknown; then taken and the rest

ascii.description: the A-label (punycode) form, the canonical spelling

cached.description: answered from our cache (available: 10 min, registered: 24 h, 1 h near expiry; unknown is never cached)

anyOf.description: The cheapest registrar to own the name for `years` (standard price; a premium name costs more).

estimated.description: the total prices a year at the regular renewal because its own regular price is unknown

first_payment.description: An amount in major units (12.99), in `currency`.

anyOf.description: An amount in major units (12.99), in `currency`.

register.description: year 1 now (a promotion when one runs)

anyOf.description: A short, sourced note about the registrar's prices (not a price we rank by).

examples: NameSilo's free discount program prices .com at $12.00 (retail $19.99).

url.description: where the note's facts come from

pricing_tier.description: retail: anyone can buy at these prices; reseller: the prices are a reseller account's tier (eNom's Silver), left out of consumer rankings unless include_resellers=true

url.description: the registrar's website (a plain link, no affiliate code)

anyOf.description: An amount in major units (12.99), in `currency`.

kind.description: api: the registrar's own price API; price_list: a file or JSON the registrar publishes; page: its price page; mirror: a third party's copy of the registrar's prices

total.description: the cost to own it for `years` (computeTco), the same number as /v1/tlds/{tld}/prices

cheapest.description: with_prices: the cheapest registrar for the extension, when the name is available or unknown

confidence.description: registry: RDAP or WHOIS answered; dns: a DNS delegation proves it is registered; none: unknown

expires_at.description: registration expiry from RDAP, when registered

premium_unknown.description: the registry's lookup can't tell a premium or reserved name from a free one (RDAP 404 on .ai, .io, new gTLDs with premium tiers): check the price at a registrar before promising it

reason.description: why the status is unknown, unsupported or invalid; or a caveat

registrable.description: true when it can be registered at a standard price as far as we can tell; null when we can't tell (unknown, or premium_unknown)

registry_status.description: RDAP status codes, e.g. ["client transfer prohibited"]

status.description: available: the registry has no such name; registered; pending_delete / redemption: registered, in the deletion cycle; unsupported: not sold to the public (a brand TLD, not in the root, no registry lookup possible); invalid: not a domain name; unknown: no registry answered (NOT available)

tld.description: the extension it is registered under (co.uk for example.co.uk)

title: Search a name across extensions
